candidates.name: CHIT1 / GPNMB / CHI3L1-CHI3L2 microglial chitinase-lysosomal phenoconversion axis
candidates.subtype: ALS-Glia and symptomatic ALS (including cross-sectional symptomatic vs pre-symptomatic C9orf72 carriers)
candidates.intervention_direction: inhibit CHIT1 chitinase amplification while preserving homeostatic GPNMB lysosomal clearance; test candidate CHIT1/NfL biomarker stratification at symptomatic conversion
candidates.mechanism: Microglial endolysosomal activation and chitinase (CHIT1, CHI3L1, CHI3L2) + GPNMB elevation observed in cross-sectional symptomatic vs asymptomatic carrier comparisons alongside prodromal axonal/synaptic stress markers
candidates.replication_status: Replicated across Cooper-Knock 2015 GSE68605 anterior horn LCM (S019; E190), historical BA9 cortical proteomics (retained as historical provenance, not D039 S-BIAD511/idr0112; E2126), 82-donor M1 snMultiome Microglia (Grozdanov/Lee et al. 2026 PMC12982666: GPNMB log2FC=+0.950, padj=7.23e-5; CHI3L1 log2FC=+1.240, padj=0.0089; E2120), D031 cervical spinal cord Visium spatial transcriptomics (Zhang/Gate et al. 2026 PMC13337491; E2120), open-access D046 NEALS/UCSF CSF discovery TMT Table 2 (N=40) and targeted PRM-MS Section 3.5 validation (Oh et al. 2023 Biomedicines 11(5):1250 PMC10215566; E2126), and open-access D045 4-center CSF proteomics (Trautwig et al. 2025 Mol Neurodegener 20:58 PMC12082929, N=259 DIA-MS across 259 unique participants: CHIT1 sALS vs Ctrl p=2.78e-12, ALS vs Ctrl log2diff=+2.2202 [p=5.17e-17], Sym vs Asym p=1.15e-14, non-significant in C9-Asym [p=0.2937] and SOD1-Asym [p=0.8819]; GPNMB sALS vs Ctrl p=6.24e-6, Sym vs Asym p=1.70e-7, non-significant in C9-Asym [p=0.6087] and SOD1-Asym [p=0.3127], Emory sALS elapsed duration since onset [AgeAtSample-AgeOnset, not progression rate] r=-0.4188 [p=0.01228]; CHI3L1 sALS vs Ctrl p=2.42e-6, Sym vs Asym p=3.30e-10, non-significant in C9-Asym [p=0.9676] and SOD1-Asym [p=0.8288], Emory sALS elapsed duration r=-0.5550 [p=0.0005399]; whereas NEFL is elevated in C9-Asym vs Ctrl p=0.005945; E2126, E2127)

reviews.strongest_counterevidence: In D031 cervical spinal cord (Zhang/Gate et al. 2026 PMC13337491), C1QC (r=-0.240, FDR=0.055), C1QB (r=-0.222, FDR=0.09), and C1QA (r=-0.164, FDR=0.33) postmortem duration correlations are all FDR > 0.05; in open-access D045 4-center DIA-MS (N=259), M9 (pink: C1QB sALS vs Ctrl p=0.000431; C1QC ALS vs Ctrl p=0.000818), M2 (blue: C3 p=0.002415), and M5 (green: C1QA p=0.01042) complement elevation is cross-sectional and non-significant in SOD1-Asym vs Ctrl (C1QB p=0.8540, C3 p=0.1896) though C1QC shows nominal elevation in C9-Asym vs Ctrl (log2diff=+0.1155, p=0.0371305); Phase 2 ASTRALS VHB937 (NCT06643481 ACTUAL n=251) cautions against unstratified glial monotherapy (E2118, E2120, E2126)
reviews.causal_alternatives: Terminal secondary complement opsonization of degenerating motor-neuron synapses rather than primary initiating driver; cross-sectional CSF complement elevation requires baseline biomarker stratification (E2120, E2126)
reviews.leakage_check: Independent open-access cohorts across historical BA9 cortical proteomics (retained as historical provenance, not D039 S-BIAD511/idr0112), 82-donor M1 snMultiome (PMC12982666), D031 Visium (PMC13337491), and D045 4-center CSF DIA-MS (PMC12082929; E2120, E2126, E2127)
reviews.genotype_check: Upregulated in 82-donor M1 snMultiome Microglia (C1QA padj=0.00089, C1QB padj=0.00054, C1QC padj=0.0019, C3 padj=0.0041; E2120) and in open-access D045 4-center CSF DIA-MS (sALS vs Ctrl C1QB p=0.000431, C3 p=0.002415, C1QA p=0.01042; Symptomatic vs Asymptomatic C1QB p=0.000243, C3 p=1.10e-5; flat in SOD1-Asym vs Ctrl p=0.8540 C1QB, p=0.1896 C3; E2126)
reviews.exposure_safety_check: Anti-C1q (ANX005) and C3 (pegcetacoplan) modalities require CSF target-engagement confirmation and meningococcal/encapsulated bacteria prophylaxis; Guardrail 3 strictly caps priority_score at 72 (raw=75; R114 F05)
reviews.decision: advance with mandatory trial-design safeguard (G3: Evidence 72 [60-81], Priority 72 [66-72; Guardrail 3 cap, raw 75], Novelty 68 [61-73]; R116); never use unadjusted serial-LP complement slopes as PD endpoint [R125/R126 triage: subtype_restricted_als_glia_only]
reviews.unresolved_blockers: Prospective validation that C1q/C3 blockade halts CSF synaptic adhesion protein loss (CNTN4/NRXN3/NRCAM) in ALS-Glia patients
reviews.next_experiment: Stratify complement trials by single-visit baseline CSF C4B/C3/C1QB + TMEM106B rs1990622 genotype and use ALS-specific CSF synaptic adhesion loss (CNTN4/NRXN3/NRCAM) as primary PD rescue readout

reviews.reviewer: Evidence-Gap Investigator;Hypothesis Challenger;Study Design Reviewer;Coordinator synthesis (G2 review)
reviews.review_method: Cooper-Knock 2015 GSE68605 (S019) LCM motor-neuron + D014 frontal cortex + open-access D045 4-center CSF verification (AR036, AR048, AR423, AR424)
reviews.strongest_counterevidence: E331 frontal bulk null; E800/E1039-E1041 unresolved soluble decoy sST2 vs membrane ST2L isoform specificity and beneficial perturbation direction
reviews.causal_alternatives: Endothelial/glial proxy confounding in bulk cortex (E1461) vs motor-neuron-enriched anterior horn LCM induction in Cooper-Knock 2015 GSE68605 S019 (+4.735 log2FC, padj=0.0086, which still captures adjacent glial/vascular processes); IL1R2 (ENSG00000115590) is a distinct decoy-receptor gene from IL1RL1 (ENSG00000115602) and is not credited as direct C007 validation
reviews.leakage_check: Independent open-access cohorts across D006 UCSD/CSHL motor cortex, D014 Mayo frontal cortex (GSE67196), and D045 4-center CSF proteomics (PMC12082929; E2126)
reviews.genotype_check: Observed in Cooper-Knock 2015 GSE68605 S019 source-sALS U provisional (+4.735 log2FC, padj=0.0086 in LCM; E190, not D006 bulk motor cortex), BH non-significant in D014 frontal cortex U8/8 (E318), and IL1RL1/ST2 is not detected in D045/D046 CSF proteomics (whereas AQP4|P55087 is a distinct astrocytic water channel that is null in D045 TMT p=0.3106 and DIA p=0.2150; E2126)
reviews.exposure_safety_check: No drug nominated; Guardrail 3 bounds priority_score (48 [39-57]) because sST2 decoy neutralization vs ST2L receptor blockade have opposite biological signs
reviews.decision: retain as exploratory anterior-horn/cortical target + astrocytic-IL33 hypothesis (G3: Evidence 50 [38-62], Priority 48 [39-57], Novelty 72 [63-80]; R116); hold therapeutic promotion pending isoform directionality
reviews.unresolved_blockers: Isoform-specific quantification (soluble sST2 vs transmembrane ST2L) in sALS motor neurons and directional rescue test
reviews.next_experiment: Perform isoform-specific sST2 vs ST2L perturbation in human sALS iPSC motor-neuron + IL33-expressing astrocyte co-cultures before selecting an agonist or decoy-neutralizing biologic
